description: SEC late filing notices (NT 10-K / NT 10-Q) — Who is filing late with the SEC and why. Form 12b-25 notices (NT 10-K, NT 10-Q, NT 20-F, NT 11-K, NT 10-D) from EDGAR. Company mode (ticker= or cik=): full late-notice history, whether each late report was filed afterwards (followUp FILED/PENDING/NOT FILED), verdict NO LATE NOTICES / OCCASIONAL LATE FILER / REPEAT LATE FILER / RED FLAG / DELINQUENT / HISTORIC ONLY. Market mode (days=1-90): every notice in the window with byForm, byDay and repeat filers; filters form= (10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, 11-K, 10-D, N-CSR, N-CEN), state= (2-letter), sic= (prefix), limit= (1-100, default 25). For the first details= notices (0-10, default 5) the Part III narrative and Part IV answers are parsed: reason categories (RESTATEMENT, INVESTIGATION, GOING_CONCERN, AUDITOR_CHANGE, MATERIAL_WEAKNESS, FINANCING_LIQUIDITY, MANAGEMENT_CHANGE, AUDIT_REVIEW_INCOMPLETE, IMPAIRMENT_VALUATION, TRANSACTION, SYSTEMS_CYBER, STAFFING, TAX, ROUTINE_MORE_TIME), whether other periodic reports are current, whether a significant change in results is expected and its explanation, and a LOW/ELEVATED/HIGH risk. Pass ticker=, cik= or days=. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
